roadmapLevels.title: Level 0: Understand UPSSSC PET
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 0: परीक्षा संरचना और पैटर्न समझना
roadmapLevels.objective: Comprehend the 100-mark OMR pattern, -0.25 negative marking, and Group C eligibility.
actionItems: Read official UPSSSC PET 2026 notification PDF
Inspect 15-subject marks distribution (especially 20 marks for DI and 20 marks for CA/GA)
Review previous year shift cutoffs and percentile formula

roadmapLevels.title: Level 1: NCERT Foundation
roadmapLevels.objective: Build fundamental concepts in History, Geography, Science, and Polity from NCERT Class 6–10.
actionItems: Study NCERT Class 6-8 History & 11-12 Themes
Master Class 9-10 Contemporary India (Geography)
Revise basic Science units (Biology vitamins, diseases, physics SI units)

roadmapLevels.title: Level 2: Core Syllabus Mastery
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 2: मुख्य पाठ्यक्रम का गहन अध्ययन
roadmapLevels.objective: Master Indian Constitution, 5-Year Plans, Indian National Movement, and Arithmetic.
actionItems: Learn all Articles 12-51A (Fundamental Rights, DPSP, Duties)
Practice percentage, fractions, average, and square roots shortcuts
Memorize Hindi grammar rules (Sandhi, Vilom, Paryayvachi, Muhavare)

roadmapLevels.title: Level 3: Uttar Pradesh Special (UP GK)
roadmapLevels.titleHi: लेवल 3: उत्तर प्रदेश सामान्य ज्ञान (UP GK)
roadmapLevels.objective: Complete UP Geography, 75 districts, 18 divisions, rivers, Dudhwa NP, and ODOP.
actionItems: Use interactive UP map to locate key districts and rivers
Learn UP state symbols, census 2011 statistics, and industrial expressways
Review 1857 Revolt centers in Uttar Pradesh

roadmapLevels.title: Level 4: Previous Year Questions (PYQs)
roadmapLevels.objective: Solve and analyze all official shifts of UPSSSC PET from 2021 to 2025.
actionItems: Solve PYQ shift-by-shift with 120-minute timer
Identify high-frequency repeating themes and question wording styles
Analyze official answer keys and commission revisions

roadmapLevels.title: Level 5: Topic-Wise Intensive Practice
roadmapLevels.objective: Attempt 1,000+ targeted practice MCQs across all 15 subjects.
actionItems: Solve 50+ questions per subject in practice mode
Record difficult questions to Error Notebook ('My Mistakes')
Focus especially on Graph and Table interpretation sets

roadmapLevels.title: Level 6: Full Length Mock Tests
roadmapLevels.objective: Simulate exact exam conditions with 100 questions, 120 minutes, and -0.25 negative marking.
actionItems: Take at least 5-10 full length timed simulation tests
Target scoring 80+ raw marks to guarantee 99+ percentile
Evaluate time spent per question and eliminate unforced errors

roadmapLevels.title: Level 7: Weak Area Improvement
roadmapLevels.objective: Target topics with accuracy below 75% using adaptive practice mode.
actionItems: Re-attempt saved questions in 'My Mistakes' error notebook
Revise specific formula sheets and short tricks
Clarify doubts using recommended book mappings

roadmapLevels.title: Level 8: Spaced Repetition Revision
roadmapLevels.objective: Execute 1-day, 3-day, 7-day, and 15-day revision cycles with flashcards.
actionItems: Review 'Today's Revision' automated queue
Flip through 200+ flashcards across subjects
Revise One-Liner GK facts for rapid recall

roadmapLevels.title: Level 9: Final Exam Simulation & Mindset
roadmapLevels.objective: Final OMR timing discipline, negative marking risk mitigation, and calm confidence.
actionItems: Final review of exam hall instructions and photo ID requirements
Maintain negative-marking risk control (avoid blind guesses)
Reach the test center well prepared for success

30Days.name: 30-Day Crash Course (Super Fast)
30Days.description: Intense regimen for candidates with prior basic knowledge aiming for rapid consolidation.

60Days.name: 60-Day Standard Preparation (Recommended)
60Days.description: Balanced approach covering all 15 subjects, NCERT basics, PYQs, and 10 full mocks.

90Days.name: 90-Day Comprehensive Zero-to-Mastery
90Days.description: Thorough coverage starting from basics up to advanced DI and 99+ percentile mastery.
